text: quantify impact with metrics (%, $, time saved)
lead bullets with strong action verbs
mirror JD keywords for ATS parsing
keep the resume to one or two pages
use reverse-chronological order for work history
tailor the resume for each job application
avoid personal pronouns like I, me, and my
use consistent formatting and fonts throughout
put the most relevant experience near the top
use bullet points instead of dense paragraphs
trim outdated or irrelevant experience older than 10-15 years
include a skills section with relevant tools and technologies
proofread carefully for spelling and grammar errors
save and submit as a PDF unless another format is requested
avoid graphics, tables, and multi-column layouts that break ATS parsing
use a professional file name like Name_Resume.pdf
open with a concise summary instead of a vague objective statement
show career progression, not just a list of job duties
replace vague adjectives with numbers and concrete results
list education after experience once you have 3+ years of work history
